text: GAC Spain announces that under a 2026/2027 agreement GAC becomes the Official Sleeve Partner of Villarreal CF, with its logo on the first team's sleeve in LaLiga, Copa del Rey and European competition; the club's own sponsors page lists Joma and GAC among its official sponsors and Pamesa Cerámica as principal sponsor.
short: Villarreal 2026/27: Pamesa principal sponsor, GAC Official Sleeve Partner, Joma kit maker.

source.name: GAC Spain, GAC patrocinador oficial de Villarreal CF
source.quote: En virtud de este acuerdo, GAC se convierte en Official Sleeve Partner del Villarreal CF. El logotipo de la compañía ocupará la manga de la camiseta del primer equipo.

additionalSources.name: Villarreal CF official website, Patrocinadores del Club (sponsors page)
additionalSources.note: The page's sponsor entries are image links titled Pamesa Cerámica (principal), then Joma, GAC, Coca-Cola, Caixabank, Ascale, Ambar (official sponsors).
